text:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — prepping Lumina Health QBR cost section. Need a token-econ snapshot, 90-day spend forecast, and any active budget alerts / renewal-risk signals. Can @Kevin pull spend + committed vs actual? @Lisa can you confirm onboarding status and any cutover risks? Target: finalize Thu EOD.

Kevin (FinOps): On it. Pulling the last 90 days now. Quick flag: their traffic shifted to embeddings-heavy search — approx 70% embed / 30% gen. Current observed burn ~2.4M tokens/day. Will post a short projection in a minute.

Lisa (Onboarding): Integration is ~90% — data ingest + webhook tests left. We have docs walkthrough Wed. Risk: auth token rotation for the connector may cause repeated re-ingest attempts on cutover which could spike calls for 24–48h. Flagging as medium risk for this QBR.

CostBot: :rotating_light: Budget alert — Lumina Health projected to reach 80% of monthly committed spend in 10 days based on trailing-7d velocity.

Kevin (FinOps): Projection (quick):
```
90d avg tokens/day: 2,100,000
Current week avg tokens/day: 2,400,000
30d growth assumption: +10% -> proj tokens/day: 2,640,000
Projected monthly tokens (30d): ~79,200,000 tokens
Committed monthly cap: 100,000,000 tokens
Estimated % of commit next 30d: 79% (with growth)
Estimated monthly cost delta if they enable full ingest burst: +18–25% extra tokens
```

Sam (Solutions): Based on that mix, quick wins: enable prefix KV caching for search, batch near-similar queries, and switch embeddings inference to 8-bit quantized variant (verified compatible with their model). Ballpark savings: 25–35% on embedding token cost + reduced egress. I can mock a before/after slide.

Ajohnson (CSM): Action items: 1) Kevin — add the numbers to the QBR doc + include commit vs actual + projection. 2) Sam — prepare a one-slide cost-savings proposal and a short eval of quantized embedding quality by Wed EOD. 3) Lisa — confirm cutover date and list mitigation (rate-limits, staged ingest). 4) Maria — I'll own stakeholder comms and renewal risk note. Can everyone confirm? :thumbsup:

Kevin (FinOps): Confirmed. I'll upload the CSV and paste a summary into the doc.

Sam (Solutions): Confirmed — will run a small AB test on quantized embed quality and share metrics.

Lisa (Onboarding): Confirmed. Tentatively holding cutover Fri AM, will update if we need to push.

Maria (CS): Perfect. Please update the shared QBR doc at /docs/qbr/lumina-health-costs before Thu 5pm PST. I'll do a final readout Thu evening and slot a 15m pre-brief with Ajohnson. Thanks all.
